recommendations.text: Offer people with post-stroke aphasia at least 20 total hours of speech-language therapy (SLT), rather than a lower total dose.
recommendations.sourceReference: Table 4, table4-23969873241311025; PICO 6(a–f) full-text consensus paragraph and Supplement 21 voting; PICO 1; recommendation 1

recommendations.text: For post-stroke aphasia, favour SLT of at least 3 hours per week rather than a lower weekly intensity.
recommendations.sourceReference: Table 4, table4-23969873241311025; PICO 6(a–f) full-text consensus paragraph and Supplement 21 voting; PICO 2; recommendation 1

recommendations.text: For post-stroke aphasia, favour SLT on at least 4 days per week rather than fewer days.
recommendations.sourceReference: Table 4, table4-23969873241311025; PICO 6(a–f) full-text consensus paragraph and Supplement 21 voting; PICO 3; recommendation 1

recommendations.text: Either digitally delivered or in-person SLT may be used after stroke; the weak recommendation reflects similar language and communication gains.
recommendations.sourceReference: Table 4, table4-23969873241311025; PICO 6(a–f) full-text consensus paragraph and Supplement 21 voting; PICO 4a; recommendation 1

recommendations.section: PICO 4b: Digital augmentation of in-person SLT
recommendations.text: For post-stroke aphasia, consider adding digital therapy to in-person SLT rather than providing usual in-person therapy alone.
recommendations.sourceReference: Table 4, table4-23969873241311025; PICO 6(a–f) full-text consensus paragraph and Supplement 21 voting; PICO 4b; recommendation 1

recommendations.text: Either group or one-to-one SLT may be used for post-stroke aphasia; the weak recommendation reflects similar gains.
recommendations.sourceReference: Table 4, table4-23969873241311025; PICO 6(a–f) full-text consensus paragraph and Supplement 21 voting; PICO 5a; recommendation 1

recommendations.section: PICO 5b: Combined group and individual SLT
recommendations.text: The added benefit of combining group with one-to-one SLT rather than one-to-one therapy alone remains uncertain; no evidence-based recommendation can be made.
recommendations.sourceReference: Table 4, table4-23969873241311025; PICO 6(a–f) full-text consensus paragraph and Supplement 21 voting; PICO 5b; recommendation 1

recommendations.section: PICO 5b: Group SLT when individual access is limited
recommendations.text: When resources limit one-to-one SLT, adding group sessions may increase therapy time, social language use and communication confidence. Follow this guideline's timing and delivery recommendations to support language recovery, communication, participation and quality of life. Consensus 12/12.
recommendations.sourceReference: Table 4, table4-23969873241311025; PICO 6(a–f) full-text consensus paragraph and Supplement 21 voting; PICO 5b; consensus 1

recommendations.text: The benefit of SLT plus transcranial direct current stimulation compared with SLT plus sham stimulation remains uncertain; no evidence-based recommendation can be made.
recommendations.sourceReference: Table 4, table4-23969873241311025; PICO 6(a–f) full-text consensus paragraph and Supplement 21 voting; PICO 6(a–f); recommendation 1

recommendations.section: PICO 6(a–f): tDCS in clinical care and trials
recommendations.text: In clinical care, prefer SLT alone to SLT plus tDCS. Individualised tDCS may have benefit but needs further evidence. Cortical or cerebellar tDCS, either side and either polarity, should accompany SLT only in high-quality trials using validated outcomes, fully described participants and adverse-event reporting even when none occur. The clinical-care statement had 10/12 agreement; the remaining statements had 12/12.
recommendations.sourceReference: Table 4, table4-23969873241311025; PICO 6(a–f) full-text consensus paragraph and Supplement 21 voting; PICO 6(a–f); consensus 1

recommendations.text: Offer SLT tailored to the individual's functional communication needs rather than therapy lacking that functional tailoring.
recommendations.sourceReference: Table 4, table4-23969873241311025; PICO 6(a–f) full-text consensus paragraph and Supplement 21 voting; PICO 7a; recommendation 1

recommendations.text: Tailor SLT language-task difficulty to the individual with post-stroke aphasia.
recommendations.sourceReference: Table 4, table4-23969873241311025; PICO 6(a–f) full-text consensus paragraph and Supplement 21 voting; PICO 7b; recommendation 1
